messages:
omar-eng: Hey all — heads-up Im planning ~60 days in Istanbul (2026-07-05 -> 2026-09-02). Partner is Turkish, Ill be staying at their place. Quick Qs before I file the form: 1) Is WFH stipend prorated for ~60d? 2) Do I need to change my homebase or is Temporary Location enough? 3) Any payroll/tax/residency risk given partner is local and I might meet a contact there? 4) I have a company MacBook and a company 27\" monitor  can ShipOps handle both? 5) Anything re: visa/entry I should prep? :flag-tr:

shelly-peopleops: Thanks Omar. Short answers: stipend = prorated by calendar days for temp moves <90d; Temporary Location form is correct path (dont change homebase unless you plan to move permanently). Well trigger payroll/legal reviews once the form is submitted.

nina-legal: Tagging in: Turkey follows 183-day residency for tax, so 60d alone usually not residency. However, working with local partners or engaging in revenue-generating activities can create presence risk earlier. If youre meeting a contact, please flag the nature of the meeting (intro vs paid consulting). Do not sign any local agreements.

vikram-payroll: Payroll notes: confirm stipend currency (USD/EUR/TRY). Stipend processed via payroll and taxed per your home payroll rules. If your stay overlaps month-ends we calculate prorate across payroll runs. If youll be paid to a Turkish bank, we need additional docs.

it-ops: Security checklist: make sure disk encryption enabled, register device with IT before travel, bring your YubiKey, avoid public Wi-Fi without VPN. If you want eSIM, request before travel.

shipops: ShipOps can ship company-owned monitor + laptop, but monitors often need different packing and local customs can charge duties. We can provide temporary export docs and insurance (company covers up to $2k per device in transit). Use shipops@redwood.com and file shipping request after case opens. Link: https://redwood.company/hr/shipping-policy

raj-manager: I approve in principle. Omar, confirm on-call coverage and any customer meetings. If youre meeting a partner for product work, loop me and legal.

shelly-peopleops: Quick checklist to attach to the Temporary Location form:
```
- Dates & full address (start_date, end_date)
- Device list (serials for MacBook + monitor, indicate if company-owned)
- Stipend currency preference
- Confirmation you remain on Redwood payroll and wont take paid local gigs
- Any planned in-person meetings with local companies (describe purpose)
- Manager approval (CC)
```

vikram-payroll: One more payroll note: if the partner is local and youre providing any compensated work for them, we need to re-evaluate immediately. Also ping payroll if you expect stay to extend past 90 days.

ticket-bot: HR case created: HR-11420 "Temporary remote: Istanbul 2026-07-05 to 2026-09-02 (Omar)"  assigned to people-ops/shelly.

omar-eng: Great, thanks everyone. Ill submit the Temporary Location form today, include device serials and mention a single introductory customer coffee (no paid work). Ill CC Raj and ping ShipOps after the case is created :thumbsup:
